tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have a minimum of three years experience in the relevant field
Registered company/ Firm/ Agency incorporated under the Indian Companies/ Society Act and have been in existence for a period of at least three years to date
The Agency should have an employee base of minimum 10 members of the above mentioned requirement to depute exclusive one personnel at the IFAB office

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- To depute 1 person seperately to IFAB
